card.title: 30th REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 30th Infantry Regiment was attached to the 3rd Division of the United States Army during WWII. It was formed in 1813 and has been involved in nearly every military action undertaken by the United States since then. During WWII the 30th participated in numerous battles and military operations including Operation Torch, Operation Husky, Operation Avalanche, Operation Shingle and Operation Anvil. In the final stages of the war the 30th Regiment was attached to the XV Corps that was tasked as the Spearhead across the Rhine into Germany. Their motto is "Our Country Not Ourselves".
